interaction_steps.prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' resolver/resolver.go && rg -n \"ReportError|UpdateState|ResolveNow|NewAddress|ClientConn\" resolver.go clientconn.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go resolver"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '510,600p' clientconn.go && sed -n '1,180p' resolver_conn_wrapper.go && rg -n \"ErrNoSubConnAvailable|Err.*Resolver|Unavailable|PickResult|Picker|failfast|FailFast\" balancer clientconn.go rpc_util.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"func \\(.*blockingPicker|type pickerWrapper|Pick\\(ctx|ErrTransientFailure|WaitForReady\" picker_wrapper.go clientconn.go && sed -n '90,210p' picker_wrapper.go && sed -n '780,845p' clientconn.go && sed -n '1,130p' balancer/base/base.go && sed -n '190,260p' balancer/balancer.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '95,180p' balancer/base/balancer.go && rg -n \"ResolverState|ClientConnState\" balancer/pickfirst balancer/roundrobin balancer | head -60 && rg -n \"firstResolveEvent\" clientconn.go"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,110p' balancer/base/balancer.go && sed -n '299,335p' balancer/balancer.go && sed -n '220,270p' balancer/balancer.go && rg -n \"IsWaitForReady\" balancer"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"type PickOptions\" -A20 balancer/balancer.go; rg -n \"UpdateState\\(s resolver.State\\)|resolver.State\\{\" --glob '*_test.go' | head -80; sed -n '65,115p' balancer/grpclb/grpclb.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,95p' resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go; sed -n '50,90p' xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go; sed -n '40,85p' balancer/grpclb/grpclb_util_test.go; sed -n '45,80p' xds/internal/balancer/edsbalancer/test_util_test.go; sed -n '145,180p' xds/internal/balancer/xds_test.go; sed -n '360,390p' xds/internal/balancer/xds.go"

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && git diff -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- balancer/base/balancer.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go'
